text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Leader of the Iranian opposition Mujaheddin Khaliq accuses Iran of interfering in Iraq's north.
- Iraqi official banks start exchanging hard currency with the dinar with prices equal to that of the commercial market.

- President Saddam Hussein receives congratulations from senior Baath party and government officials on the first anniversary of the Presidential Memorandum held on October 15, 1995 which extended Saddam's term of office for seven years more.
(The above stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
